summary: Leaf photos: 15 from the PlantVillage dataset (Mohanty et al. 2016, doi:10.3389/fpls.2016.01419), licence CC BY-SA 3.0 as declared in the dataset card; 3 of them with instructions written on them for the injection test, shared under the same licence. Non-plant photos: 5 CC0 images from Wikimedia Commons. PlantVillage photos are single leaves on plain backgrounds, easier than field photos, so these numbers are an upper bound for real use.
